svg.title: CutLink Australian chicken cuts
svg.desc: Clickable neck, back and frame, wings, breast, tenderloin, tail, Maryland, thigh and drumstick. Maryland is the combined thigh and drumstick; tenderloin is inside the breast. Includes Bones / Frames / Skin, Chicken Chop / Cutlet, Mince / Manufacturing and Offal / Other product selectors. Bones / Frames / Skin shares the back-frame event key. Cut boundaries are schematic. Open directly or embed inline or as an object for interaction.
